TABLE.NAME: repository_largefile_chunks
TABLE.COMMENT: Tracks chunked uploads of large files. id, userid, contextid, maxlength and state are set when the token is created; the remaining fields are filled as chunks arrive.

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Upload token generated when the picker screen renders.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who owns the upload.

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Context the upload was started in.

FIELD.NAME: maxlength
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum allowed bytes, or -1 for unlimited.

FIELD.NAME: lastmodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the row was last touched, for cleanup.

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: 0: token generated, not used; 1: upload started; 2: upload completed.

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the uploaded file.

FIELD.NAME: length
FIELD.COMMENT: Total expected file length in bytes.

FIELD.NAME: currentpos
FIELD.COMMENT: Bytes written so far.

FIELD.NAME: receivedmap
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of received byte ranges for an out-of-order (Background Fetch) upload.

TABLE.NAME: repository_largefile_peers
TABLE.COMMENT: Trusted peer sites this site can share backups with, paired by a shared secret.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable name of the peer site.

FIELD.NAME: baseurl
FIELD.COMMENT: The peer's site URL; its host is the only one exempt from the site cURL block when importing a share.

FIELD.NAME: sharedsecret
FIELD.COMMENT: The pairing secret, encrypted at rest with the site key.

TABLE.NAME: repository_largefile_shares
TABLE.COMMENT: Files published to a peer as an encrypted, expiring, signed download.

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: Public share identifier used in the download URL.

FIELD.NAME: peerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Peer allowed to fetch this share.

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Original (plaintext) file name.

FIELD.NAME: filesize
FIELD.COMMENT: Plaintext size in bytes.

FIELD.NAME: sha256
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the plaintext, for integrity checking after decryption.

FIELD.NAME: salt
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-share key-derivation salt (hex).

FIELD.NAME: expires
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time the share expires, or 0 for never.

FIELD.NAME: maxdownloads
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum successful downloads, or 0 for unlimited.

FIELD.NAME: downloadcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Successful downloads so far.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the share.

TABLE.NAME: repository_largefile_nonces
TABLE.COMMENT: Spent request nonces, for replay protection of signed share downloads.

FIELD.NAME: nonce
FIELD.COMMENT: A one-shot request nonce.

TABLE.NAME: repository_largefile_transfers
TABLE.COMMENT: Queued or scheduled server-side transfers (URL import, peer share import) run unattended by the scheduled task.

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Transfer kind: urlimport or shareimport.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User the transfer runs for and as.

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Context the transfer was created in (used when staging a URL import).

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Best-known target file name, for display.

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON parameters for the transfer (a URL, or a peer id and share URL).

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: scheduled, running, completed, failed or cancelled.

FIELD.NAME: scheduledtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Earliest time the transfer may run; 0 means as soon as possible.

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of run attempts so far.

FIELD.NAME: progress
FIELD.COMMENT: Percent complete (0-100) of a running transfer, for display.

FIELD.NAME: progressupdated
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the percent last advanced, to distinguish a slow run from a stalled one.

FIELD.NAME: error
FIELD.COMMENT: Last failure message, if any.

FIELD.NAME: result
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the finished transfer landed, for display.
